subject: a teacup that was cracked and mended, its cracks joined with brass seams
sourceSummary: Write a blameless incident postmortem after a production outage or degradation — a structured, factual document covering the impact, a precise timeline (detection → diagnosis → mitigation → resolution), the root cause and contributing factors via a five-whys analysis, what went well and what went poorly, and concrete, owned, dated action items that prevent recurrence.
